Robyn (CS): Quick weekly NovaQuery health check. Onboarding 68%, renewal flags in Q3, saw p99 regressions on /completion non-stream yesterday afternoon. Posting compact route/model breakdown and notes.

Hector (SE): thanks, paste the numbers + any immediate mitigation suggestions.

Robyn (CS): Rolling 7d; p95/p99 in ms, error%, daily reqs.

```
route        model      mode         p95  p99   err%  req/day
/chat        t5-medium  streaming    240  850  0.28  14k
/chat        t5-medium  non-stream   430 1250 0.95   3.1k
/completion  gpt-lite   sync         710 2100 2.6    5.5k
/embed       micro      streaming     52  150  0.03  47k
/rerank      llama2     non-stream   1150 2900 3.7    920
```

Lin (SRE): rerank tail looks consistent with big batches plus intermittent OOMs. We saw 4 OOMs on their dedicated pool between 02:40-03:05 UTC.

Alex (Customer): We had an internal job that retried 5x because of a 504 and that blew up latency for a minute. Only affected a small cohort but visible in metrics.

Hector (SE): Streaming improves p95 ~40% and tightens p99 for /chat. Recommend enabling streaming in staging. For rerank, suggest limiting batch token count to 1500 and adding early failure for extreme latency.

Robyn (CS): Action items:
- Hector: prepare a 1-pager runbook for batching limits and early-exit heuristics, share by Tue.
- Lin: add temporary pool headroom (+1 GPU) and capture OOM traces; escalate if >3 OOMs in 24h.
- Robyn: send renewal health summary and embed spend cap options to Alex.

AlertBot: Created ticket CH-2440-11 assigned to Lin "NovaQuery dedicated pool OOMs + rerank tuning".

Hector (SE): quick curl example to turn on streaming for chat routes:

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
  -d '{"route":"/chat","model":"t5-medium","stream":true}'
```

Alex (Customer): Will enable streaming in staging tonight and exercise a synthetic p99 test. Also please include a suggested embed cap in $$ terms.

Robyn (CS): Noted  will include dollar ranges and renewal talking points. Next brief sync Monday 9am PT. :calendar:
